items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Cecil Scott. The mention comes from a third party (PS) identifying Kenneth Roane as having played in a band with Cecil Scott. The interviewee only confirms the identity of Kenneth Roane.

ctx.x: 1924 I come to New York, that's my first time in New York - not to stay, but my first time in New York. But in two weeks time - in Harlem it was over a hundred clubs, you know. And I heard, that's where I heard Tricky Sam, the same trombone player that wrecked it, in little places. I even remember, I think I remember the name, it went Green Hornet or Green Dragon or somethin' like that, in Harlem around 30 somethin' street and Lenox Avenue, in that neighborhood. Anyway I may be not exact about the date, but he…
PS: Same guy who played with like among other bands, he played with a band from Springfield, Ohio, the Cecil Scott/Lloyd Scott -
